basics.name: Uttam Kumar
basics.label: Full-Stack Web Developer
basics.summary: Full‑stack developer (MERN) with hands‑on experience building and deploying production‑style apps. Shipped an end‑to‑end e‑commerce platform with Stripe payments, JWT RBAC, REST APIs, and realtime chat. Strengths: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, TypeScript, and cloud deployments on Vercel/Render with MongoDB Atlas.

work.name: Freelance Project - ShopHub E-commerce
work.summary: Delivered a full-stack MERN e-commerce application with secure payments and an admin panel.
highlights: Integrated Stripe Payment Intents for secure checkout with success/cancel handling
Implemented JWT authentication with role-based access control (admin, user)
Built 20+ REST endpoints (auth, products, orders, payments) with centralized error handling

projects.name: ShopHub E-Commerce Store (Full-Stack MERN)
projects.description: Production-ready MERN e-commerce with payments, auth, admin, reviews, and orders.
projects.techStack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Stripe, JWT, Vite
highlights: Cart, checkout, order history, and an admin dashboard for product and order management
REST API for auth/products/orders/payments built with Express and Mongoose
Stripe Payment Intents flow: create, confirm, and handle failure states

projects.name: Realtime Chat Site
projects.description: Express + Socket.IO app for 1-to-1 realtime messaging with online users list.
projects.techStack: Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
highlights: Socket.IO-powered 1-to-1 messaging with rooms to isolate conversations
Login UI and online users list for quick pairing
Deployed to Render; Express serves static client and WebSocket endpoint

projects.name: MERN Payroll Management Dashboard
projects.description: Role-based payroll and leave management with charts and secure auth.
projects.techStack: React (TypeScript), Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind, MUI, Recharts
highlights: JWT authentication with refresh tokens and CORS policies
KPI visualizations using Recharts with responsive layouts
